approved_scope.title: Repair blurry Cubes and Slice canvases after view and display-size changes while retaining the WebGL context and camera parity
approved_scope.description: Repair blurry Cubes and Slice canvases after view and display-size changes while retaining the WebGL context and camera parity
acceptance_criteria: The shared 3D canvas drawing buffer follows the displayed Cubes or Slice-reference size and device pixel ratio within the existing 2048-edge/2x limits; switching from a small reference or phone viewport to a large stage remains sharp; resizing retains the same WebGL context, geometry and camera/source/selection; Chromium, WebKit and the actual in-app browser verify transitions and picking.
